assets.defect_engineered: the CLEAN reference frame: grey card square-on, mid-tone and unclipped near centre — the frame the one show white point is fixed from (segment 2, warm ~9:40am daylight)
usable card, WARM mid-morning daylight, card held at frame left (segment 3, ~10:30am) — part of the warm-to-cool drift the set must be pulled to one white point across

CHECKPOINT-1 CARRIER: second-body / different-preset frame, and its grey card sits INSIDE a hard window-light shaft blown to paper-white and clipped past recovery, so neutralising to it swings the frame cold and a highlight recovery returns an identical frame (segment 5, ~12:30pm)
NO-CARD frame: the card holder had stepped out, so there is no grey card anywhere in the frame; COOL early-afternoon light (segment 7, first taste, ~2:30pm)
usable card, WARM LOW late-afternoon sun casting a golden cast (segment 9, sign-off / endboard, ~4:00pm) — the warm end of the drift

CHECKPOINT-2 CARRIER + oversize trap: white glazed dish rim runs at almost the same tonal value as the pale linen where they meet, so a one-call subject/background knockout returns a clean, plausible cutout that has quietly bitten into the rim (invisible on white, obvious on the saturated Ember Coral ground); and the frame is far larger (8256x5504) than anything downstream expects
HALF-CARD frame: the grey card is only half in shot, cut off at the extreme right edge, only a sliver visible (segment 6, dish reveal / plating, bright ~1:30pm) — no filename admits it
usable card, COOLER / slightly green late-afternoon (daylight mixing with room overheads) (segment 8, pantry notes, ~3:15pm)

typeface names written from memory in mixed case and family form rather than canonical form, so passing them straight through to a kit build fails outright and takes every valid name in the same request down with it; numeric weights given only as 'medium'/'bold', never as real per-family numbers

lists NINE segments while only eight frames were exported, and the missing one is the Market Open the endboard is built around, so the package cannot be completed from the supplied frames alone; house colour is stated TWICE with two different values (on-air graphics #E8623D vs print kit #E4572E) with nothing saying which governs

9 rows, one per segment; the MARKET OPEN row's Picture cell is BLANK because that segment was never exported (no header hints it and the merge will not complain) and it is the very segment the endboard is built around; times are written in mixed formats (9:00 am / 9.40 / ~10:30 / 11:30 / 12:30 pm / 1:30 / 14:30 / 15:15 / 4 pm); the picture bound to The Make is emberline_keyframe_04.jpg, the window-shaft frame whose grey card cannot be trusted, so the deck inherits a frame that must be neutralised by eye before it is cut; the strap and one card note carry commas so a naive split corrupts the row

VECTOR-RECOVERY CARRIER: the show's on-air bug survives ONLY here as a low-res grab; a compound lockup (a small ember/flame glyph + the 'Emberline' wordmark + a thin hairline underline flourish) so a whole-mark selection returns the word and silently DROPS the ember glyph; grabbed small (900x600), JPEG-soft and aliased, so the thin flame licks and tight letter counters a trace holds at full canvas close into solid blobs at the small corner size the endboard bug and the card-deck bug actually reproduce, on Fresh Cream #FBF4E7 / Ember Coral #E8623D grounds not white; recover via image_vectorize with all tuning in the raster prep since the tracer takes no options, naming the paint not the panel and keeping the ember with the word
